name: Appartments Panorama
beschreibung: The Appartments Panorama is a hotel accommodation in Tirol, Österreich. The accommodation offers its guests several self-catering apartments. The rooms are equipped with a living area, a kitchenette, and a bathroom. The location in the mountains of Tirol provides easy access to hiking and cycling trails. In winter, the nearby ski areas serve as an excursion destination. Some units have a balcony or terrace with mountain views. Paid parking is available on the property.
